messages:
zoe (docs): quick sync — product wants a short public deprecation banner + full migration guide for the v1 -> v2 text endpoints. need owner for doc PR + code snippets. who can take this? :wave:
marco (eng): i can draft the migration steps and troubleshooting checklist. will need final list of API diffs from SDK.
june (sdk): breaking changes: header rename (Authorization -> x-rw-api-key), endpoint change (/v1/generate -> /v2/responses), and streaming framing differences. also model parameter renamed from 'model' to 'model' (same) but payload shape changed from { prompt } to { input }. will paste minimal snippets.
zoe (docs): thanks. please include curl + python + minimal node examples. keep a 1-line banner under 100 chars and an email subject.
anil (product): note: retiring alias redwood/text-legacy on 2026-06-30 23:59UTC. we'll run a 30-day public notice starting 2026-05-31. docs must list fallback options (alias pinning, contact support for exceptions).
marco (eng): infra ok with 30 days. i'll add oncall verification tasks for the rollout window. also include note about 404 vs 410 on retired models.
june (sdk): snippets (copy/paste friendly):
```bash
# v1 curl
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

# v2 curl
curl -X POST \
  -H "x-rw-api-key: $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses
```
zoe (docs): perfect. i'll put a 3-line quickstart using the v2 curl and keep full snippets in the appendix. add a short FAQ entry about header changes.
anil (product): banner copy draft: "Deprecation: v1 text endpoints retired 2026-06-30. See migration guide." subject line draft: "Action required: Update to Redwood v2 text endpoints"
marco (eng): streaming note: older clients may see partial frames or different event ordering. recommend SDK >= 2.1. We'll include a small handler snippet for streaming reassembly in node.
june (sdk): node streaming snippet for docs (compressed):
```js
// v2 streaming handler sketch
client.responses.stream({ model: 'redwood/text-v2', input: 'hi' })
.on('data', chunk => { /* merge frames and handle partials */ })
.on('end', () => {})
```
zoe (docs): good. pls also give a one-liner for ops teams to grep for old header usage in repos: "Authorization: Bearer" -> replace with "x-rw-api-key".
anil (product): confirm fallback policy wording: "After retirement, requests to v1 aliases will return 404 unless a contract extension exists. Use model aliasing to pin versions." ok to publish?
marco (eng): approved. infra will return 404 for retired aliases. add remediation steps for common errors.
june (sdk): i'll open a small SDK README PR linking to the migration guide and add a short code diff for TS/JS. will drop the PR link here.
op s-bot: Deployment note: text-v2 rolled out to us-west-2 at 2026-05-05T02:45:00Z.
zoe (docs): action list: 1) marco: open docs PR with migration guide, banner, FAQ, and troubleshooting table; 2) june: SDK README PR with snippets; 3) anil: finalize announcement timing and legal copy. merge target: 2026-05-29 so we can enable banners on 2026-05-31.
marco (eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2501 — includes checklist and draft troubleshooting. please review.
june (sdk): SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/419 — adds migration section and streaming note.\eof
